about: knap5 KN_SUB1_FIT (w120, 2026-11-12): measured whole-model KL ratios of swj'd 27B mixes with sub-1 trunk levels, ratio = KL(mix) / KL(ref mix), same slice, same V2 3.00 head (ours-K4) + embedding (e3). Each solved anchor fixes an extra scale on every sub-1 option at K 'fit'. Splices: layer l even -> K.even, odd -> K.odd. Pending anchors (skip) are filled from their results; see sub1plan.md. Fit anchors are mixed-K mixes (like the knapsack's), uniform sub-1 mixes are checks (w120 dry run 11-12: kfit2's depth compounding over-predicts uniform sub-1 mixes: fitted to U0.5 = 4.10 x U1 the model puts the splice at 0.97 x U1 vs 1.93 measured; a saturation link C cannot reconcile them (degenerate fit). See sub1plan.md).
